scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -k 'npm exec -w @manuelselch/pi-sdk -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch' 'npm exec -w @manuelselch/pi-server -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch'
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @manuelselch/pi-sdk && npm run build -w @manuelselch/pi-server
scripts.test:tooling: node --test scripts/__test__/*.test.mjs && npm run test:tooling -w pi-chat
scripts.verify:packages: npm run build:packages && npm run verify:package -w @manuelselch/pi-sdk -w @manuelselch/pi-server
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: npm run test:e2e:coverage -w pi-chat && node scripts/report-package-coverage.mjs --chat-e2e
scripts.test:e2e:coverage:run: npm run test:e2e:coverage:run -w pi-chat && node scripts/report-package-coverage.mjs --chat-e2e
